title: Transit Visa Check
description: Stops travellers booking a layover that needs a visa they don't have: checks the passport against sourced airport transit visa lists (UK, Germany, France, Netherlands; US has no airside transit) and the traps that force you through the border (self-transfer, onward Schengen flight, UK to Ireland, leaving the airport), applies the documents that exempt you, and links the official source and Timatic.
stops: Stranded at a layover without a visa
